<USER_REQUEST>
Please investigate why the the-brain-watcher unit keeps restarting on boot. Check the journal for the last hour, read the unit file, and tell me whether the ExecStart path still matches the merged repo layout. This is the fixture user request and it needs to be long enough that the observation char threshold is comfortably exceeded by the conversation delta.
</USER_REQUEST>
<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>
The current local time is: 2026-06-12T11:00:00+01:00.
</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>
<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>
The user changed setting `Model Selection` from None to Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium). No need to comment on this change if the user doesn't ask about it.
</USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>
TOOL-NOISE-MARKER unit file contents that must never reach an observation
TOOL-NOISE-MARKER journalctl output that must never reach an observation

The watcher unit restarts because ExecStart still points at the pre-merge tsx shim. The unit file needs the direct node invocation from the merged layout. I have confirmed the journal shows exit code 203 on every boot attempt.
